note: At least 35% below 2005 levels by 2035, from the 2035 NDC submitted in December 2024. The US has since withdrawn from the Paris Agreement, so this target no longer reflects current federal policy.
Conditional on international support. NDC 3.0 projects fugitive methane from the energy and waste sector falling by about 42% by 2035 under its conditional pathway. No baseline year is given.

Government estimate that existing and planned measures will cut methane by more than 35% below 2020 levels by 2030 (Faster and Further: Canada's Methane Strategy, 2022). The formal sector target is at least 75% below 2012 levels for oil and gas by 2030.
11% below FY2013 levels by FY2030 (Japanese fiscal years; 30.0 to 26.7 Mt CO2e), from the gas-by-gas breakdown in Japan's NDC.

Energy-sector target under Korea's 2030 Methane Emissions Reduction Roadmap. The roadmap also sets an economy-wide target of 30% below 2020 by 2030, plus 34.2% for agriculture and livestock and 49% for waste.
Target in Ukraine's National Energy and Climate Plan to 2030, approved by the Cabinet of Ministers in June 2024. Matches the Global Methane Pledge benchmark.
At least 30% below 2020 levels by 2030. Under Decision 942/QĐ-TTg (August 2022), total methane is capped at 77.9 Mt CO2e by 2030. Sector caps include 3.5 Mt CO2e for coal mining.
